descriptions.zh: 我们开始过载§H[target.GetName]§!来播种§Y宇宙风暴§!。
descriptions.en: We have begun supercharging §H[target.GetName]§! to seed a §YCosmic Storm§!.

descriptions.zh: 我们开始过载§H[target.GetName]§!来播种§Y宇宙风暴§!。
descriptions.en: We have begun oversaturating §H[target.GetName]§! to seed a §YCosmic Storm§!.

descriptions.zh: 我们正操纵§H[target.GetName]§!的恒星风来播种§Y辐射风暴§!。
descriptions.en: We are manipulating §H[target.GetName]§!'s stellar winds to seed a §YRadiant Storm§!.

descriptions.zh: 我们正在切断围绕在§H[target.GetName]§!周围的电场来播种§Y电力风暴§!。
descriptions.en: We are severing the electron fields surrounding §H[target.GetName]§! to seed a §YElectric Storm§!.

descriptions.zh: 我们正在操纵环绕§H[target.GetName]§!的离子来播种§Y磁力风暴§!。
descriptions.en: We are manipulating the ions surrounding §H[target.GetName]§! to seed a §YMagnetic Storm§!.

descriptions.zh: 我们正在扰动围绕§H[target.GetName]§!的分子来播种§Y粒子风暴§!。
descriptions.en: We are agitating molecules around §H[target.GetName]§! to seed a §YParticle Storm§!.

descriptions.zh: 我们正在破坏§H[target.GetName]§!的重力场来播种§Y重力风暴§!。
descriptions.en: We are destabilizing the gravity fields of §H[target.GetName]§! to seed a §YGravity Storm§!.

descriptions.zh: 我们正在搅乱围绕§H[target.GetName]§!的天体星尘来播种§Y星尘风暴§!。
descriptions.en: We are scrambling the celestial dust around §H[target.GetName]§! to seed a §YStardust Storm§!.

descriptions.zh: [owner.capital_scope.GetName]的极端天气揭示了风暴中令人振奋的力量。如果我们掌握了对行星天气的控制，我们就可以在宇宙尺度上利用这些知识。建造风暴吸引建筑将会加速我们追寻终极风暴的进程。
descriptions.en: Intense weather on [owner.capital_scope.GetName] has revealed the exhilarating power of storms. If we master the control of planetary weather, we could harness that knowledge on a cosmic scale. Constructing storm attraction buildings will accelerate our progress towards the ultimate storm.
